turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good afternoon, Sofia! How is your Friday going so far? I hope you managed to get some good rest after your ER shift.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's going okay, just a bit slow to wake up today. I started my afternoon with a warm, spiced black tea with steamed milk. It really helped me shake off the post-shift sleepiness.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and cozy. Did you have a busy night at the hospital?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. The ER was chaotic last night, which is pretty typical for a Thursday night in Phoenix. Because I was so exhausted, I ended up booking a ride through an app on my phone to get home this morning instead of driving myself.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That was definitely a smart decision. Safety first, especially after a grueling night shift. Did you at least get a chance to eat something decent while you were working?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, thankfully. I managed to slip away for a few minutes and grab a leafy green salad from the hospital cafeteria. It wasn't anything fancy, but it kept me going.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good, I'm glad you got some sustenance. Are you planning on doing any salsa dancing this weekend to unwind, or are you just going to catch up on sleep?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd love to go salsa dancing at some point this weekend if my energy levels allow for it. It's always a great way to decompress, but we'll see how I feel tomorrow.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, listen to your body first. How is the Phoenix weather treating you today? It must be starting to get quite warm now that we're in May.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, it is definitely heating up! The desert sun is no joke today, so I'm glad I can just stay indoors and relax for now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Indoor relaxation is perfect for a Friday afternoon. Is Tom keeping you company, or are you having some solo downtime?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's working right now, so I'm just enjoying some quiet solo time before he comes over later this evening.

first_try_failures: invention: User and Tom are planning to go salsa dancing at their usual spot tomorrow night.
